name: Homura Shouko
source:
The only daughter of the dojo which practices the blazing style sword technique. An active person, whose body moves before thinking. Has outstanding motor skills but is completely ignorant in the ways of studying.

Always carries the demon sword "Kannagi" with herself.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050507113203/http://210.166.209.38:80/html/soft/flove/chara_c.htm]website[/url]]
